query:
SELECT 
  cpr.id,
  cpr.segment,
  cpr.city,
  cpr.tenantId,
  cpr.userId,
  u.name as userName,
  t.name as tenantName
FROM commercialPointRequests cpr
LEFT JOIN users u ON cpr.userId = u.id
LEFT JOIN tenants t ON cpr.tenantId = t.id;
